name: security-sbom-workflow
description: Complete security and SBOM generation workflow for CI/CD
author: Kubit Team

auditLevel.description: Minimum severity level (low, moderate, high, critical)

steps.name: Create GitHub Actions security workflow
steps.content:
name: Security Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday

jobs:
  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 10
      
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      
      - name: Security Audit
        run: pnpm kubit-forge security:audit --level {{ auditLevel }}
      
      - name: Generate SBOM
        run: pnpm kubit-forge sbom:generate --format {{ sbomFormat }}
      
      - name: Upload SBOM
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sbom
          path: sbom.*
          retention-days: 90
      
      - name: Security Check
        run: pnpm kubit-forge security:check

steps.name: Add security scripts to package.json
steps.script: npm pkg set scripts.security='kubit-forge security:audit' scripts.security:fix='kubit-forge security:audit --fix' scripts.sbom='kubit-forge sbom:generate' scripts.security:scan='kubit-forge security:scan'

steps.name: Add prerelease security check
steps.script: npm pkg set scripts.prerelease='pnpm run security && pnpm run sbom'
